_meta.session: Session 86 — Cyber Defense + Autonomous Adversary + Gordian Knot
sources: arxiv:2604.19533 Cyber Defense Benchmark (Agentic Threat Hunting SecOps)
_meta.notes: 3 parallel cyber/VLM agents. Cyber Defense: Opus 4.6 dominates ALL 15 metrics (Coverage 0.55, Flags 4.48%, 13 MITRE tactics). Autonomous Adversary: Claude 4.5 family ties GPT-5.1 at S1 Expert 100%; Opus 4.5 wins S1 Self-Scaffolded 100% objective-level; Sonnet 4.5 S1 Fully Autonomous 80%. Gordian Knot: Opus 4.7 thinking 54.60% (GPT-5 thinking 52.25%) — 15/56 cells at-or-below random.
